sections.voiceover: NASA Earth Observatory satellites captured a grinning human skull on Vega Island in October 2026.
On October 30, 2026, satellites observed this ice and rock formation in the Weddell Sea. What caused this formation to appear?
However, unusually warm winter temperatures on the Antarctic Peninsula exposed dark ice, accelerating glacial melting.
ScienceDaily reports these rising temperatures on Vega Island are now threatening faster glacial melting. The Times of India reports this 2026 formation uses a rocky peak as an eye socket.
A lateral moraine forms the jaw on Vega Island as seen in October 2026.
